# Sajal Birla

> Personal portfolio of Sajal Birla, a full-stack software engineer at Autodesk in Bengaluru, India, building AI-powered tools and scalable web applications.

This portfolio presents Sajal's professional experience, technical skills, resume, and contact links. The canonical website is https://sajalbirla.github.io/sajal-portfolio/. The HTML portfolio uses React; the Markdown overview below can be read without executing JavaScript. Section anchors are locations within the same page, not separate pages.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio overview in Markdown](https://sajalbirla.github.io/sajal-portfolio/index.md): Readable summary of the profile, employment history, skills, and professional links.
- [Portfolio website](https://sajalbirla.github.io/sajal-portfolio/): Main website and canonical source.
- [Resume](https://sajalbirla.github.io/sajal-portfolio/Resume_Sajal_Birla_Developer.pdf): Downloadable professional resume in PDF format.

## Professional profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/sajalbirla): Public repositories and developer profile.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sajalbirla): Professional profile.
